'''''Breakthrough''''' was the title of a [[Painting/Legends|painting]] depicting [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial forces]] breaking through [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] fortifications. It showed an [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|AT-ST]] and [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] firing their weapons at unseen [[Alliance Military/Legends|Rebel forces]].

==Behind the scenes==
''Breakthrough'' is a painting in the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''. It was available as a [[:w:c:swg:Loot card|loot card]] in the ''[[Star Wars Galaxies Trading Card Game]]''{{'s}} seventh expansion ''[[The Price of Victory]]'' and could be redeemed for an copy of the object in the MMORPG.

Players can use them to decorate their [[:w:c:swg:Housing|virtual homes]]. As an additional feature, owners of these paintings can use them to receive the player titles "[[Underlord]]," "[[Xizor Transport Systems/Legends|XTS]] Executive" and "[[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] Koppo [[Vigo/Legends|Vigo]]" which can be displayed beneath the player's name.
